clue.text: Line taken by hanger-on in animal shelter

indicators.note: the line is taken on by the hanger-on, so it comes after it

parts.note: a bur (or burr) is a prickly seed head that clings on, so a hanger-on
a row is a line of things

explanation.surface: A rope line is grabbed by a clinging stray inside an animal pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabbit or fox digs a hole in the ground for its home, a shelter for the creature.

clue.text: It's put up to 'protect one from cats and dogs

definitions.text: It's put up to 'protect one from cats and dogs

parts.words: It's put up to 'protect one from cats and dogs
parts.note: raining cats and dogs means pouring rain, so this is something raised overhead against heavy rain, not against pets

explanation.surface: Something is erected to keep pets away from a person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cats and dogs' suggests a fence against animals, but it is the idiom for very heavy rain.
explanation.definitionFit: A folding canopy carried overhead keeps rain off its holder, hence protection in a downpour.

clue.text: Glow one displayed during part of army social gathering

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, a part of the British Army

indicators.note: the numeral appears in the middle of the gathering, so it goes inside that word

parts.note: a dance is a social gathering
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone shines at a military social function.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiance is a bright shining light, a synonym for glow.

clue.text: Miserable looking individual after nothing's caught in snare, say

indicators.note: the individual comes after the rest of the wordplay
the nought is trapped inside the snare word

parts.note: a web is a trap or snare, as a spider's
O is the figure nought, nothing
EG (for example) is what 'say' means
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: Someone looks unhappy after catching nothing in a trap.
explanation.definitionFit: Woebegone describes a face or manner showing sorrow and distress.

clue.text: My generosity like this could produce surprised reaction

definitions.text: My generosity like this could produce surprised reaction

parts.words: My generosity like this could produce surprised reaction
parts.note: a word for kindness, put after 'My', makes an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: A person's generous act might cause astonishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Goodness means kindness or virtue, and 'my goodness!' is an exclamation of surprise.

clue.text: Hurry to start cooking fish?

definitions.meaning: skates are flat fish, so putting them on the stove starts cooking them

explanation.surface: Get a move on to begin preparing the seafood dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom urges someone to move quickly, as though fitting wheels to their feet.

clue.text: Doctor takes in most of friends, being a trifler

indicators.note: the doctor abbreviation surrounds the trimmed friends word
only most of the word is used, its last letter dropped

parts.note: allies are friends

explanation.surface: A medic befriends several people and is a time-waster.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dallies dawdles or toys idly, much as a trifler fritters time away.

clue.text: Morality play with all-male cast?

definitions.meaning: a famous fifteenth-century English allegorical drama

explanation.surface: A medieval moral drama is performed only by men.
explanation.definitionFit: The best-known medieval morality play has a title figure representing all humanity.

clue.text: For example, packet's going back, using drastic procedure

parts.note: stern means severe or drastic
a way is a method or procedure

explanation.surface: A parcel is returned by some severe method.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Packet' looks like a parcel, but a packet is a packet boat, a mail ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Sternway is a vessel's backward motion through the water, and a packet boat is one such ship.

clue.text: Law-abiding eastern girl gets into nothing crooked

parts.note: O is the figure nought

indicators.note: the eastern girl goes inside the crooked word

parts.note: bent means crooked or corrupt
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

explanation.surface: An honest eastern woman ends up somewhere dishonest.
explanation.definitionFit: Obedient means complying with rules or orders, as a law-abiding citizen does.

clue.text: Claim the lot, say, attracting envy at first

parts.note: all means the lot, everything
EG (for example) is what 'say' means

indicators.note: only the opening letter of envy is taken

explanation.surface: Someone claims everything, drawing jealousy from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: To allege is to assert or claim something, usually without proof.

clue.text: Reportedly pose with oriental sea mammal

indicators.note: signals that the words are heard spoken rather than written

parts.note: pose means sit (for a portrait), and oriental means Asian

explanation.surface: Someone poses with an Eastern sea creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Cetaceans are the order of marine mammals including whales and dolphins.

clue.text: Clawback's secured by country person

indicators.note: the reversed claw holds the word by inside it
the claw word is read backwards

parts.note: a nail is a claw, as on an animal's toe
taken as written

explanation.surface: A refund is guaranteed by a person from some nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clawback' looks like a single word for a refund, but it splits into claw and the reversal signal back.
explanation.definitionFit: A Libyan is a native of Libya, a North African country.

clue.text: Part of one's goal, to die like Tennyson?

definitions.meaning: the horizontal bar on top of football goalposts
Tennyson's poem 'Crossing the Bar' is about death, so to die is to cross the bar

explanation.surface: Part of a personal ambition is to die as the poet Tennyson did.
explanation.definitionFit: The beam joining the tops of goalposts is a part of the frame of a goal.

clue.text: Deserted, but a group of players have performed inside

indicators.note: the performed word goes inside the group word

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians
done means performed or carried out

explanation.surface: A musical group has given a show and then been left alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Abandoned means left behind and empty, a synonym for deserted.

clue.text: Apart from first two, seeds appear identical

indicators.note: the seeds word loses its opening pair of letters

parts.note: sesame is a plant grown for its seeds

explanation.surface: Seeds look alike except for the first couple.
explanation.definitionFit: Same means alike or identical.

clue.text: Cab-ranks arranged as place for urgent fare

indicators.note: the letters of the taxi ranks are set out in a different order

explanation.surface: Taxi ranks are set up as a place for passengers in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fare' suggests a taxi passenger, given the cab-ranks, but here it means food.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick-service eatery provides fast food, food for someone in a hurry.

clue.text: Scarf and sort of shirt wrapped in paper

indicators.note: the shirt letter is enclosed by the paper word

parts.note: manilla is a strong brown paper
T, as in T-shirt

explanation.surface: A scarf and a shirt come packaged in paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantilla is a lace scarf or veil worn over the head by Spanish women.

clue.text: Sole cricket side needed, leathery in the extreme

parts.note: the on side is one half of a cricket field

indicators.note: the extremes of leathery are its first and last letters, which are the ones taken here

explanation.surface: A single cricket team is wanted, toughened at the edges.
explanation.definitionFit: Only means single or sole, as in an only child.

clue.text: Scraps with eccentrics on the way up

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on top of another comes first

parts.note: odd men are strange people, eccentrics

indicators.note: in a down clue, the way word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Bits of rubbish lie with odd folk on the road heading upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Oddments are leftover bits and pieces, scraps.

clue.text: Held by the French, a trial game

indicators.note: a trial goes inside the French article

parts.note: le is French for the
a cross is a burden or trial to bear

explanation.surface: French people hold a test of a sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacrosse is a team sport played with netted sticks.

clue.text: Sailor has two sets of cards

parts.note: a deck is a full set of playing cards
a hand is the set of cards dealt to one player

explanation.surface: A seaman carries a pair of card packs.
explanation.definitionFit: A deckhand is a member of a ship's crew doing manual work, a sailor.

clue.text: Debate giving athletics equipment to son

parts.note: a discus is thrown in athletics

explanation.surface: An argument arises over handing sports gear to a boy.
explanation.definitionFit: To discuss is to talk over or debate something.

clue.text: Most appealing copper brought to trial

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a test is a trial

explanation.surface: The most charming police officer is put in the dock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman on trial, but it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutest is the superlative of cute, meaning most charming or attractive.

clue.text: It indicates the maximum or minimum wavelength

definitions.text: It indicates the maximum or minimum wavelength

parts.words: It indicates the maximum or minimum wavelength
parts.note: not radio waves: a line on a shore showing how high or low the sea reached

explanation.surface: Something marks the highest or lowest wavelength of a signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A line left on a beach or bath showing the water's highest level is such a mark.

clue.text: Singer repeats top score for listeners

indicators.note: signals that the doubled word is heard rather than read

parts.note: in darts the bull is the top score, and it is repeated

explanation.surface: A vocalist keeps returning to the highest mark when heard.
explanation.definitionFit: The bulbul is a songbird of Asia and Africa, a singer.

clue.text: Lucidity irregularly seen in school sick bays

indicators.note: the jumbled word goes inside the sick bays word

parts.note: a san is a sanatorium, a school sick bay; plural sans

indicators.note: the letters of seen are disordered

explanation.surface: Clear thinking is occasionally spotted in school infirmaries.
explanation.definitionFit: Saneness is soundness of mind, so clarity or lucidity of thought.

clue.text: Again give out rule covering animal

indicators.note: the rule word surrounds the animal word

parts.note: to reign is to rule
an ass is a donkey, an animal

explanation.surface: A rule is reissued to cover an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: To reassign is to allocate again, give out once more.

clue.text: Hurried to get swearword toned down

explanation.surface: Someone rushed off to have their curse softened.
explanation.definitionFit: Dashed means ran quickly, and as an exclamation it softens a stronger oath.
